rev.t: Bhola's The Photo Store in Indiranagar is hands down the best place in Bangalore for photography gear. My friend recently bought a Canon EOS R6 Mark II bundled with the 50mm f/1.8 STM lens, and the overall buying experience was exceptional. …
We came here to get a photo clicked with reference picture. Sanjay was very polite and he took some extra shots also along with the already given reference. Really great job done by him. …

I recently visited Bholas in Indiranagar after struggling to find a studio that could create a customized photo frame within my budget for a corporate event. The experience exceeded my expectations. Sanjay personally assisted me throughout …
